entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello? I... I need to make a return.
Hi there, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Alex. I can definitely help you with that today. To get started, could you tell me your name and the product you're calling about?
It's Sarah Miller. I have the new VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor.
Okay, Sarah, I see your account here. Before we go further, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, no, it's not broken or anything. It's just... I can't use it now. Things have changed. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I just... I really need the money back right now.
I understand. I just need to confirm the purchase date to check on the return eligibility. When did you receive the VeloBand?

It was about a month ago. I know it's been a while... my father had a sudden medical emergency right after it arrived. He was rushed to the hospital and needed major surgery. I haven't even had a moment to think about anything else. It's still in the box.
Oh my, I am so sorry to hear about your father's emergency. Please don't worry about the delay at all. Let me just pull up your order... okay, I see you received it on December 15th.
Yes, that's it. Is it... is it too late? With everything going on with his surgery and being in the hospital, I completely forgot.
Not at all, Sarah. You are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you right now. No problem whatsoever.
Oh, really? Ninety days? Oh, thank you so much, Alex. That is such a huge relief. I was so worried. Thank you.

Of course. It's the least we can do, and I hope your father has a speedy recovery. I've just initiated the return. You'll receive a pre-paid shipping label in your email within the next 15 minutes. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office.
I will. Thank you again. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and please take care.
